title: The board and team who steward Autism Sanctuary.
excerpt: Governance and day-to-day leadership for our nonprofit care farm—supporting people with significant needs through licensed services on Pea Ridge Road.
html:
Meet the volunteer board and staff leaders who guide Autism Sanctuary’s mission, programs, and daily operations. Portraits and biographies can be updated here in EmDash as materials are ready.

Board and management rosters appear below this introduction on the public People page.
